inputs.text: An Indiana judge has blocked a law challenged by the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice on religious-freedom grounds. Calling that a threat to “unborn life” misses the real issue: the state should not impose one moral or religious view on everyone or deny people control over their own lives. Religious freedom must protect people whose beliefs differ from the lawmakers behind abortion restrictions, especially when those restrictions burden people with the fewest resources.

output.main_topic: Religious freedom and opposition to abortion restrictions that impose moral or religious views
